finite_acceptance_scope.ThinLensCameraTest.PupilSamplesSpanFinit: 320x180/FOV52/focal50/aperture2/focus30,pixel(237,71),film(.35,.65),pupils(.25,.64),(.70,.36). Pupil radius>0 and<=original aperture radius; forward direction>0; independent focus-plane intersections5e-6.
finite_acceptance_scope.ThinLensCameraTest.OversizedPupilDecline: r1/focus1/focal100/aperture1 violates original r_pupil<=.1*min(r_observer,d_focus). Configuration issue and original precondition death assertion; no new boundary sample.
finite_acceptance_scope.CameraSampling.SequenceDoesNotCollapseFi: Exactly4096 emitted/observed original deterministic samples; every film/pupil coordinate strictly(0,1). Mean[(film_u-pupil_u)^2+(film_v-pupil_v)^2] within.01 of1/3; no random-uniform/all-sequence claim.

reference.kind: Existing original geometric, finite-difference, plane-solid-angle, rectangle, Lorentz and sequence assertions; no new oracle or stronger threshold.

equations.normalized_direction: n=q/|q|; its tangent is (I-n*n^T)*dq/|q|; existing independent test geometry is normalized in double then finite-differenced, not a copied production derivative.
equations.fixed_pupil: Intersect the original fixed pupil ray with its requested focus plane.
equations.moving_frame: Original independent Lorentz transform of physical photon q'=(1,-n).
equations.four_columns: Original five-point complete-launch variations in film x/y pixels and physical Cartesian pupil right/up; stochastic disk-map differentiation is outside this test.

reference.representation_boundary: Original float lens coefficients and legacy-ray roundoff budgets are retained; these finite checks do not establish all-configuration bounds.
